overview.title: Fósiles marinos antiguos
overview.p1: Long before the Sahara became a sea of sand, this region was covered by a prehistoric ocean teeming with marine life. Today, local workshops unearth, cut, and polish incredible fossils dating back hundreds of millions of years.
overview.p2: Visiting a fossil workshop offers a fascinating look into local craftsmanship. You can observe artisans carefully extracting trilobites from rock matrices and shaping polished marble inlaid with prehistoric ammonites and orthoceras.
overview.p3: Easily paired with a desert 4x4 excursion or as a stopover between Erfoud and Merzouga, visiting the workshops is an educational and memorable experience for geology enthusiasts and curious travelers alike.

moods.subtitle: Craftsmanship, history and unique souvenirs — three key aspects.

1.title: Artisan Crafting
1.desc: Watch local artisans cut, shape, and polish stone blocks embedded with ancient fossils.

2.title: Showrooms
2.desc: Browse impressive museum-quality specimens, from giant ammonites to delicate trilobites.

3.title: Unique Collectibles
3.desc: Purchase authentic small fossils or decorative pieces directly from the source.

tips.title: Practical Tips for Visiting Fossil Workshops

1.title: Shipping Heavy Items
1.desc: Large marble tables and heavy fossil pieces can usually be shipped internationally by reputable workshops.

2.title: Cash & Bargaining

q1.question: ¿Se pueden visitar los talleres?
q1.answer: Sí, talleres y salas de exposición reciben para ver extracción, corte y pulido.

q2.question: ¿Mejor momento?
q2.answer: Mañana o final de tarde para evitar el calor del mediodía entre Merzouga y Erfoud.

q3.question: ¿Se pueden comprar fósiles auténticos?
q3.answer: Sí, desde pequeños trilobites hasta grandes mesas de mármol incrustadas.

q4.question: ¿Duración de la visita?
q4.answer: Unos 45 a 60 minutos para un taller y exposición.

q5.question: ¿Dónde están los talleres?
q5.answer: Sobre todo entre Erfoud y las afueras de Merzouga, accesibles en 4x4 o traslado.
